purpose: The specification document describing the invention, filed as either a Provisional specification (early description) or a Complete specification (full disclosure with claims). Attached to Form 1.

fee.note: No fee on the face of Form 2; the fee is handled with the Form 1 filing.

layout.notes: Form 2 is a Provisional OR Complete specification — a top-level strike-out choice that governs the preamble (Section 3) and the applicability of Claims (Section 5) and the Abstract (Section 7). Most sections are large free-text areas whose content continues on separate pages.

fields.label: PROVISIONAL / COMPLETE
fields.helpText: Determines the preamble, and whether Claims and the Abstract apply.

autofill.derivation: Detect from the uploaded specification: the presence of claims/abstract and the preamble wording indicates Complete; their absence indicates Provisional. The user confirms.

fields.label: Title of the invention
fields.helpText: Must match the title on Form 1, Section 5.

validation.message: Enter the title of the invention.

sections.title: 2. APPLICANT(S)
sections.description: Sub-fields (a)-(c), repeated per applicant. Repeat boxes in case of more than one entry.

fields.label: (a) NAME
fields.helpText: Name of the applicant should be given in full, family name in the beginning.

fields.label: (c) ADDRESS
fields.helpText: Complete address of the applicant should be given stating the postal index no./code, state and country.

sections.title: 3. PREAMBLE TO THE DESCRIPTION
sections.description: Pre-printed preamble text, selected by the specification type. Only the applicable column is retained; the other is struck out.

fields.text: PROVISIONAL — The following specification describes the invention.
COMPLETE — The following specification particularly describes the invention and the manner in which it is to be performed.

sections.title: 4. DESCRIPTION
sections.description: Description shall start from next page.

fields.label: Description
fields.helpText: The description continues on separate pages. Description shall start from next page.

validation.message: Enter the description of the invention.

sections.title: 5. CLAIMS
sections.description: Not applicable for a provisional specification. Claims should start with the preamble — 'I/we claim' — on a separate page.

fields.label: Claim
fields.helpText: Claims are given on a separate page and should start with the preamble 'I/we claim'.

sections.title: 6. DATE AND SIGNATURE
sections.description: To be given at the end of the last page of the specification.

autofill.derivation: Default to the preparation / signing date; editable.

sections.title: 7. ABSTRACT OF THE INVENTION
sections.description: To be given along with the complete specification on a separate page.

fields.label: Abstract of the invention
fields.helpText: Given on a separate page along with the complete specification.

notes: Note. - Repeat boxes in case of more than one entry.
Note. - To be signed by the applicant(s) or by authorized registered patent agent.
Note. - Name of the applicant should be given in full, family name in the beginning.
Note. - Complete address of the applicant should be given stating the postal index no./code, state and country.
Note. - Strike out the column which is/are not applicable.
Claims and the Abstract are not applicable to a provisional specification; selecting PROVISIONAL hides those sections without discarding any content already entered.
Drawings and sequence listings accompany the specification and are declared on Form 1 §13; they are not fields on the face of Form 2.
No fee is payable on the face of Form 2; the fee is handled with the Form 1 filing.

printedHeader.statute: THE PATENT ACT, 1970 (39 of 1970) and THE PATENTS RULES, 2003
printedHeader.subject: PROVISIONAL / COMPLETE SPECIFICATION
